_comment: The Dawn palette, version 3, single source of truth for any tool that needs to ask whether a colour belongs to the brand. Generated to agree with section 3 of docs/brand/HBP-Brand-Style-v3-Dawn.md, which overrides every older choice. Two grounds: documents are ivory, the app and the site are the field.
_trademark: Every appearance of the mark carries a trademark symbol beside it, and the first text mention of the programme name carries one too. See section 2 of the brand style and brand/DAWN-NOTES.md.
